items.source: an InetSocketAddress with the extracted host and port, or null if the headers are not present
items.translation: 一个包含提取的主机和端口的 `InetSocketAddress`，或者如果标头不存在则为 `null`。

items.source: headers - the request headers that may contain forwarded headers
items.translation: headers - 可能包含转发请求头的请求头

items.source: In most cases, you should not use this class directly but rather rely on ForwardedHeaderFilter for Spring MVC or ForwardedHeaderTransformer in order to extract the information from the headers as early as possible and discard such headers. Underlying servers such as Tomcat, Jetty, and Reactor Netty also provide options to handle forwarded headers even earlier.
items.translation: 在大多数情况下，您不应直接使用此类，而应依赖 Spring MVC 中的ForwardedHeaderFilter或ForwardedHeaderTransformer，以便尽早从标头中提取信息并丢弃这些标头。底层服务器（如 Tomcat、Jetty 和 Reactor Netty）也提供了选项来更早地处理转发标头。

items.source: Note: There are security considerations surrounding the use of forwarded headers. Those should not be used unless the application is behind a trusted proxy that inserts them and also explicitly removes any such headers coming from an external source.
items.translation: 注意： 转发标头的使用涉及安全考虑。除非应用程序位于可信代理之后，该代理会插入这些标头并显式移除来自外部源的此类标头，否则不应使用它们。

items.source: Adapt the scheme+host+port of the given URI from the "Forwarded" header (see RFC 7239) or from the "X-Forwarded-Host", "X-Forwarded-Port", and "X-Forwarded-Proto" headers if "Forwarded" is not present.
items.translation: 从"Forwarded"标头（参见RFC 7239）或如果不存在"Forwarded"标头，则从"X-Forwarded-Host"、"X-Forwarded-Port"和"X-Forwarded-Proto"标头中，适配给定URI的 scheme+host+port。

items.source: Parse the first "Forwarded: by=..." header value to an InetSocketAddress representing the address of the server.
items.translation: 解析第一个"Forwarded: by=..."标头值，将其转换为表示服务器地址的InetSocketAddress。

items.source: Parse the first "Forwarded: for=..." or "X-Forwarded-For" header value to an InetSocketAddress representing the address of the client.
items.translation: 解析第一个 "Forwarded: for=..." 或 "X-Forwarded-For" 标头值，将其转换为代表客户端地址的 `InetSocketAddress`。

items.source: a UriComponentsBuilder that reflects the request URI and additional updates from forwarded headers
items.translation: 一个反映请求 URI 以及来自转发头部的额外更新的UriComponentsBuilder。
headers - 要检查的 HTTP 标头
